text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout 'green-v2' -> eu-west-1 showing 15% 5xx over baseline, started 3m ago. Impact: elevated 5xx and latency spike. Auto-canary paused.

maria (oncall): Got the page, jumping in. Checking canary metrics now.

ashok (sre): I see spikes coincide with new DNS entries for green-v2 LB pointing to partial pool. Some requests show 503 from proxy, others 200.

jules (platform): @maria can you confirm which hosts are in the green pool? I pushed the green subset yesterday for blue/green route shift.

maria (oncall): running:
```
$ rctl rollout status green-v2 --region eu-west-1 --json
{ "healthy": 78, "unhealthy": 22 }
```

kevin (eng): 22% unhealthy is consistent w/ canary. Any client error codes? logs show intermittent upstream reset + TLS handshake timeouts.

ashok (sre): digging logs -> proxy 502/503 from a handful of nodes that had an inconsistent cert rotation. Could be certs not loaded after the restart.

jules (platform): That matches my deploy plan — nodes were restarted with a cert reload. I rolled certs to green pool last night. If certs not present, DNS might route to green IPs but connection fails.

maria (oncall): TL;DR: Partial rollout + cert mismatch causing errors. We need to stop traffic to green immediately. Options: 1) Kill feature flag that flips traffic to green 2) Update DNS to shorten TTL and revert 3) Rollback green -> blue.

sre-rotation: On-call handover in 30m, pls keep incident notes here.

jules (platform): Easiest fast mitigation: flip the route policy to send 0% to green in the router config (no DNS churn). Doing now:
```
# platform CLI
$ rctl route set-weight --name=eu-west-1 --variant=green-v2 --weight=0
```

ops-bot: @maria invoked rctl route set-weight (green-v2=0) — change queued, ETA 12s.

maria (oncall): Confirmed: traffic to green now ~0% per telemetry. Error rate dropping on edge.

ashok (sre): Good. While traffic is cut, we should assess customer impact and whether any cached DNS will still hit green IPs.

customer-success: We're getting some inbound messages from one enterprise customer in eu-west complaining about request failures since ~10:12. They saw intermittent 5xx for ~4 mins.

maria (oncall): Logging customer impact: short blip, not widespread. Will follow up after rollback.

kevin (eng): For completeness, I pulled curl tests from multiple EU nodes, some still hit green IP because of DNS TTL. We set TTL=300s on LB records — old clients can keep hitting for ~5m.

jules (platform): We can do immediate rollback of the deployment artifact too — but since route weight is 0, rollback is lower risk. I want to verify the certs on green nodes before reattempt.

maria (oncall): Agree. Plan: 1) Keep green weight=0 2) Verify certs on green nodes 3) If certs can be hot-fixed, test with a small internal canary 4) If not, rollback to blue and re-run rollout after fix.

ashok (sre): I'm ssh-ing into the problematic green nodes: `/srv/certs/` missing new intermediate chain on 3 hosts. Probably the cert apply job failed mid-rotation.

jules (platform): Ugh. Looks like our cert-apply job didn't retry on transient storage timeout. I'll open a quick fix to re-run cert apply with retry:
```
$ k run job cert-apply-green-v2 --restart=OnFailure --env RETRY=3
```

ops-bot: Job cert-apply-green-v2 started on k8s cluster eu-west-1, pods=3.

maria (oncall): While that runs, let's prepare rollback just in case. @kevin can you stage the rollback?

kevin (eng): On it. Staging rollback: `rctl rollout rollback --name=green-v2 --to=blue-v1 --region=eu-west-1 --dry-run` -> looks good.

ashok (sre): Cert job finished, intermediate chain present on all nodes. Restarting proxies on green pool to pick up certs.

ops-bot: Proxy restart triggered on 3 green nodes.

kevin (eng): Running quick smoke tests from multiple EU vantage points.

kevin (eng): Smoke: 200s from all vantage points. Latency normal.

maria (oncall): Telemetry confirms errors back to baseline. I'll keep green weight at 0 for 10m to let TTL expire, then we can consider a small internal canary (10% internal).

jules (platform): Also toggled a temporary monitor to watch TLS handshake failures specifically.

customer-success: Sent a proactive note to the impacted customer explaining short service blip and actions taken.

maria (oncall): Incident status: mitigated (traffic diverted), root cause: cert-apply job failed mid-rotation causing missing chain on some green nodes during canary. Impact: brief 5xx spike affecting a subset of eu-west requests, a handful of enterprise customers reported transient errors.

ashok (sre): Post-incident actions: 1) Make cert-apply job idempotent + retries 2) Add pre-rollout cert verification check in rollout pipeline 3) Add DNS TTL rollback guidance in runbook.

jules (platform): I filed a PR to add retry logic and verification step -> https://git.internal/repo/pull/782 (WIP).

maria (oncall): Handoff notes for next on-call (@sre-rotation): incident mitigated, green weight set to 0, cert job retried and fixed, rollback staged but not executed. Please monitor for 30m and sign off before we re-enable traffic.

sre-rotation: Acknowledged. Taking over monitoring.

maria (oncall): Closing thread for immediate action items. I'll open a formal postmortem and link back here. :memo:

ops-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026-1021 updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, owner=maria.

jules (platform): Thanks all. Follow-ups tracked in the postmortem.

customer-success: Customer updated; they'll watch and let us know if they see any more issues. :white_check_mark:

maria (oncall): End of thread.
